title: Saving New Customer creates the customer with the chosen term and limit
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-06 Fourteen.
  • A name for the new customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-06 Customer.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type {Customer-A} in Customer Name.
  3. Choose {Term-A} in Credit Terms.
  4. Type 800 in Credit Limit.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: the field shows the name as typed.
  • Step 3: the dropdown shows {Term-A}.
  • Step 4: Credit Limit reads 800.
  • Step 5: the window closes and the new customer is saved.
  • Step 6: the "Credit term" reads {Term-A} and the credit limit is $800.00. No extra screen was needed to set the term.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R6: “On Save, the customer is created with the chosen term and limit.”
  • Goals: “Creating a customer on a non-default term takes zero extra screens: the term is set on New Customer itself.”
